coordination.reason: Those lanes own MicroClay serving/shadow packing, retrieval-receipt context propagation, and replay budget/limit identity. This delta introduces a separate method-memory substrate and does not create competing semantics for those contracts.

hypotheses.claim: Explicit structural problem signatures can discriminate useful analogies better than surface lexical similarity for the first bounded Stage-B substrate.
Method context can be retrieved while preserving UNKNOWN factual status and zero truth/effect authority.

strongest_counterhypothesis.claim: Explicit structural signatures may themselves be wrong, incomplete, or hand-authored in a way that merely moves the hallucination problem into the signature layer.
strongest_counterhypothesis.consequence: Keep the path SHADOW-only. Do not infer structural facets from free text into ACTIVE authority until extraction, replay, counterexample, contamination, and held-out transfer gates are validated.

unusual_experiment.description: A lexically attractive framework was given an explicitly wrong structural signature while a generically named framework matched the target structural facets. The structural retriever selected only the structurally matching method.

observed_assertions: FACT_UNKNOWN remained UNKNOWN when method_context was present
user-scoped method did not cross to the other user
PRESENT evidence did not trigger Stage-B by default
extra candidate structural facets are penalized symmetrically
normalized duplicate signature values fail closed
